node.title: Pricing: each minimal circuit contributes O(1) slopes via the deficiency-one machinery (direct reuse)
node.statement: A minimal circuit is a ONE-DIMENSIONAL kernel with independent deletions — exactly the deficiency-1 situation. The U-ladder's Cramer/eliminant dichotomy (u1/u2, in flight in #199) applies verbatim: each circuit yields at most O(1) unpaid slopes (eliminant branch) or lands in a named paid/structured branch (identically-valid branch). The M5 ladder built for A=384 prices the spread exceptions too — direct machinery reuse across walls.
